grammar.title: Emphasis with 特别
grammar.explanation: 特别 (tèbié) means "especially, particularly" before an adjective, adding stronger emphasis than 很. It can also mean "special, unusual" when describing a noun.

grammar.title: Before and after: 以前 vs 以后
grammar.explanation: 以前 (yǐqián) means "before", and 以后 (yǐhòu) means "after". Both follow the time or event they refer to: 三点以前 (before three o'clock), 下课以后 (after class). Either can stand alone to mean "in the past" or "from now on".

sentences.zh: 以前我不喜欢喝茶，现在很喜欢。
sentences.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ bù xǐhuan hē chá, xiànzài hěn xǐhuan.
sentences.en: I didn't like tea before, but now I like it a lot.

sentences.pinyin: Sān diǎn yǐqián nǐ néng lái ma?
sentences.en: Can you come before three o'clock?
From now on, I want to work harder.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì yí gè tèbié de bànfǎ.
